meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 把旧版NanoClaw和Claude原生记忆（如.seed.md、CLAUDE.md、自动记忆等）安全迁移到新的共享记忆树，并整理成统一格式。操作前会暂停任务、征求批准，迁移后生成报告并可回滚。
howto.when: 在共享记忆升级出现破坏性变更后，或发现组里仍有旧记忆文件时触发；也可直接说“migrate memory”等指令。

say.note: 开始检查并迁移旧格式记忆文件。

say.text: 迁移后检查我之前的记忆还在不在
say.note: 验证迁移结果并测试回忆。

howto.what_en: Migrates legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory (e.g., .seed.md, CLAUDE.md, auto-memory) into the shared memory tree, organizing it into a unified format. Pauses tasks, asks approval, produces a report, and supports rollback.
howto.when_en: Runs after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when legacy memory files remain; also triggered by phrases like 'migrate memory'.

say_en.note: Starts checking and migrating old-format memory files.

say_en.text: After migrating, check if my old memories are still there
say_en.note: Verifies migration results and tests recall.

say_en.text: Also move CLAUDE.local.md into the new memory tree
